scope_limit: This is a bounded ledger of currently observed feature families, not a claim that all Prism features have been enumerated. Artifact recovery is not implementation; a passing reference case is not full parity.

status_semantics.partial: A subset is implemented, with explicit missing obligations

status_semantics.unresolved: Evidence required to decide or implement behavior is missing
